item.creatif.ingredient_filter.tooltip.s: _Matches ingredients_ against _basin contents_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components. Output slot is optional.
gui.creatif.match_any.description: Will start processing recipe if one or more of the specified items are in the basin.
gui.creatif.match_all.description: Will start processing recipe if all of the specified items are in the basin.
gui.creatif.item_fluid.description:
Filters fluids with respective fluid container.
(default Create behavior)
gui.creatif.raw_fluid.description:
Filter fluids with raw fluid only. Fluid containers now filter only items.
Containers may be emptied into a slot by right clicking to get the raw fluid.
gui.creatif.item_fluid_enabled: This item will match a _liquid_ ingredient due to selected settings!
gui.creatif.raw_fluid_disabled: Raw fluids are disabled, this slot will not be used for filtering.
